content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Amritsar Academic Associate - Trainee Recruitment 2026. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIM Amritsar Academic Associate - Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Academic Associate - Trainee post is 17 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIM Amritsar Academic Associate - Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Academic Associate - Trainee post in IIM Amritsar Recruitment 2026. This is a great opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIM Amritsar Academic Associate - Trainee posts?
faq.answer: As per the official notification, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for the Academic Associate - Trainee posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIM Amritsar Academic Associate - Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Academic Associate - Trainee post is 30 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India rules for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Academic Associate - Trainee at IIM Amritsar?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Academic Associate - Trainee post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 25,000/- - Rs. 35,000/- per month. This is a competitive salary for the position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IIM Amritsar Academic Associate - Trainee?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Academic Associate - Trainee post primarily involves an Interview, which may be conducted either online or offline as decided by IIM Amritsar.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications for Academic Associate - Trainee?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a two-year post-graduate degree in relevant fields like M.Sc, MCA, M.A (Economics, Operations Management), M.Com (Finance & Accounts), or MBA from a UGC/AICTE recognized university/Institute.

faq.question: Q8. When does the application process start for IIM Amritsar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process for the Academic Associate - Trainee position commenced on 04 August 2026. Interested candidates can start applying from this date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Academic Associate - Trainee position?
faq.answer: The Academic Associate - Trainee position at IIM Amritsar is a Contractual job type. This offers an opportunity to gain valuable experience in a prestigious institution.
